# Changelog

## Unreleased

### Security
- Upgraded fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity — unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affected versions <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0).

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: bump `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (2.9.4 is a fixed version per the advisory; staying in the 2.x series to avoid a major-version jump)
- `CHANGELOG.md`: note the security fix under Unreleased

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `8305fb2db1`: **passed**

Merging into main requires code owner approval, so @alex please review and approve.
